big_story.headline: RBI Urges Push for Small Business Loans
big_story.subhead: GOVERNOR SANJAY MALHOTRA CALLS ON BANKS TO EXPAND CREDIT TO MICRO ENTERPRISES
paragraphs: Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra has urged commercial banks across the nation to step up lending to small and micro enterprises. Speaking on the critical role of grassroots capital, the central bank chief highlighted that small businesses can deliver up to 100 times more economic impact from institutional loans. The call comes as policymakers seek greater economic gains through broader credit distribution across India's developing commercial ecosystem.

Micro and small enterprises have historically faced tight credit bottlenecks despite serving as vital engines for employment and local productivity. Governor Malhotra pointed out that expanding formal banking channels to these enterprises will unlock significant commercial potential while enhancing overall financial stability. By encouraging lenders to look beyond traditional corporate credit, the RBI aims to deepen financial inclusion across tier-two and tier-three markets.

As banks evaluate their credit allocation models, the central bank's stance signals a strategic pivot toward priority micro-lending. Analysts expect commercial lenders to introduce tailored credit products and streamlined underwriting processes for small business owners in the coming quarters. Market observers will be closely tracking quarterly credit growth figures to assess whether banks effectively answer the central bank chief's call.
big_story.pullbox: Small business credit can generate up to 100 times more economic impact, prompting the RBI to urge banks to expand lending to micro enterprises.

explains.title: What is Priority Sector Lending?
paragraphs: Priority Sector Lending is a framework mandated by the central bank that requires commercial banks to allocate a specific portion of their total credit to key high-impact economic sectors. These designated sectors typically include agriculture, small enterprises, social infrastructure, and low-cost housing.

Under these rules, banks must ensure that targeted loans reach borrowers who might otherwise struggle to secure capital from traditional commercial channels. If a bank fails to meet its required sector targets, it must deposit the shortfall into specified government development funds.

Indian space tech startup SatSure has raised ₹60 crore ($7 million) in fresh capital from the government-backed space fund Antariksh Venture Capital Fund. The Earth observation and satellite technology firm relies on satellite data and artificial intelligence to deliver geospatial insights across sectors.

The startup is now targeting a larger ₹200 crore Series B funding round to further scale its satellite fleet and advanced analytical capabilities. By integrating satellite imagery with deep-tech algorithms, SatSure aims to expand its market footprint while building critical space infrastructure in India.

story_1.headline: Nepal PM’s India Visit Signals Fresh Momentum
paragraphs: The recent diplomatic engagement between India and Nepal has taken a fresh turn with the Nepal Prime Minister's official visit focusing closely on energy, economy, and strategic bilateral cooperation. Observers note that this high-level meeting sets the stage for stronger cross-border infrastructure and trade ties in the region.

As both nations seek to deepen their economic partnership, new avenues for joint energy ventures and regional stability are being actively explored. This visit underscores the ongoing commitment to mutual growth and diplomatic engagement between the two neighboring countries.

story_2.headline: Small Businesses Can Deliver 100 Times More Impact
paragraphs: The Reserve Bank of India chief recently highlighted that small businesses hold the potential to deliver one hundred times more impact from loans compared to larger counterparts. Speaking on the critical role of micro and small enterprises, leadership emphasized the need for targeted financial support to drive grassroots economic growth.
Banking institutions are being urged to scale up credit access for these smaller entities to maximize employment generation and financial inclusion across the country.

story_3.headline: Rupee Climbs Past 93/USD as Shorts Unwind
paragraphs: The Indian Rupee recently strengthened past the 93 mark against the US Dollar as international investors sought shelter in domestic equities and market participants unwound their short positions.

geopolitics.headline: Less Pressure on US Trade Deal Post Midterm Elections
paragraphs: India faces reduced pressure to finalize its trade deal with the US following the midterm elections, according to Emkay Global. Donald Trump praised India's economic growth while pushing for lower US interest rates. The evolving political landscape gives New Delhi additional flexibility in negotiating key commercial terms.

However, US inflation reached 3.6% in September, complicating interest rate decisions for the Federal Reserve. Indian trade strategists now have extra time to align domestic export policies before commitments are locked in. The outcome of these prolonged discussions will shape bilateral commerce between the two countries.
